<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“What if Shera decides to attack us while we’re running around on our own?”}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|— ''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 9}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Shera Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Shera, also known as [[Gardener]] Shera, is a highly skilled [[Consultant]] and [[assassin]] within the [[Guild]]. As a member of the [[Gardeners]]—a group responsible for 'pruning' unwanted elements like weeds—she serves under the [[High Gardener]], [[Kerian]]. Shera has risen to the rank of [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Guild Head]], leading a team of ten [[Soulbound Gardeners]]. She is characterized by her lethal combat abilities, often utilizing bronze [[shears]], daggers, and poisoned [[needles]]. Her physical capabilities include superhuman agility, the ability to manifest claws, and a capacity for intense concentration that allows her to suppress her emotions. Shera is recognized as a formidable and dangerous figure, described by some as a major threat to humanity. She is a [[Soulbound]] who has bound her essence to an ancient weapon, creating a connection between the [[Emperor's power]] and the [[Guild]]. Throughout her various missions, she has engaged in high-stakes combat against [[Champions]], [[Guards]], and the [[Children of Nakothi]]. While she is often perceived as a passionless or inhuman killer, she has also displayed moments of exhaustion and weariness regarding her duties and the pursuit of immortality.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Shera is a blond woman with short black hair and bright orange eyes featuring vertical slit pupils. She often wears gray hooded clothing, a half-[[The mask|mask]] covering her nose and mouth, and has been noted to have a missing right ear and a line of [[blood]] across her cheek.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Described as lazy, unpredictable, and possessing a mentality of pure chaos, Shera is a professional [[assassin]] who can become dark and cold. She is motivated by her duties as a [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Guild Head]] and [[Consultant]], though she also shows an interest in breakfast over guild history.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Shera is an apprentice of [[Ayana]] and a student of [[Jarelys Teach]]. She is an ally and associate of [[Lucan]], who has done everything for her and seeks to protect her, and she was adopted into the [[Consultants]] by [[Kerian]]. She is an ally of [[Meia]] and has been a rival or enemy to [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]], whom she eventually killed, as well as [[Urzaia Woodsman|Urzaia]], [[Kamba Nomen]], and [[Kelarac]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a [[Soulbound]] [[Gardener]] and [[Consultant]], Shera utilizes the power of [[Bastion]] to create cages of thorny gold light and manipulate [[silver mist]]. Her combat skills involve the use of [[spades]], poisoned [[needles]], gas [[bombs]], alchemy flares, and various blades, including her Awakened green [[shear]] and the weapon [[Syphren]]. She is also capable of stealing power from [[Elderspawn]] to create green wisps or fireball spirits.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Life in the Capital}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Originally a beggar on the streets, Shera was born in the underside of the Capital where she worked cleaning the city under [[Rudeus Maxwell|Maxwell]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c3" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 4</ref> She carries a small knife and has a hidden pocket sewn into the inside of her clothing, having previously pulled a blade on [[Kerian]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c3" /> A member of the [[Guild]]'s order of assassins who has left her [[Workshop|workshop]], Shera carries a bronze [[shear]] in her right hand and another on her left that she never draws.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4" /> In addition to her [[shears]], which she can use as a weapon, she possesses a [[paralyzing needles|paralyzing needle]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c6">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 6</ref> Conditioned by [[Rudeus Maxwell|Maxwell]]'s attacks to respond to the slightest sounds, Shera once used a stolen knife to attack a prisoner by seizing his wrist and pushing it against his body.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c5">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 5</ref> She is more interested in breakfast than [[Guild]] history and has visited a familiar clearing in the forest.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c5" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c6" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Consultant training}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|After being adopted into the [[Consultants]] by [[Kerian]], Shera became a prospective [[Consultant]] whom [[Lucan]] sought to protect.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c19">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 19</ref> She is the intended user of the weapon [[Syphren]] and is a professional with knowledge of ships.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c19" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c20">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 20</ref> A [[Gardener]] undergoing [[Consultant]] training, Shera traveled toward [[Meia]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c20" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c21">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 21</ref> While running deeper into [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]], she could hear a faint heartbeat echoing across the entire island.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c21" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c22">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 22</ref> Wearing a [[The mask|mask]] over her nose and mouth, the fighter utilized [[shears]] and [[spades]] in combat.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c23">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 23</ref> During an encounter in the arena, Shera was stopped by [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] but managed to catch her Awakened [[shear]] out of the air.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c23" /> She wielded a bronze [[shear]] in her right hand and a green one in her left, supplemented by alchemy flares, [[needles]], and hidden daggers.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c23" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c24">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 24</ref> Her expression remained absolutely blank, characterized by eyes as dead as a snake's.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c24" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Gray Island}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|While on [[Gray Island]], Shera demonstrated the ability to steal power from [[Elderspawn]], a process that produces green wisps around her body.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c25">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 25</ref> She is also capable of creating a pale [[spirit]] of a fireball and once attempted to strike the Elder with her [[shears]] while falling.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c25" /> Known as [[Gardener]] Shera, she later received a small scroll tied with a green ribbon from a [[Waverider scout]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c26">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 26</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c27">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 27</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Guild Head of the Gardeners}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Shera serves as the [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Guild Head]] of the [[Gardeners]], possessing short dark hair and ice-cold eyes with crushing depths.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 23</ref> A line of [[blood]] is drawn across her cheek, and she was once pulled back into the mist by a thorny vine of golden light.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15" /> Her mentality is perceived as pure chaos, appearing as though three people inhabit her body.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15" /> Wielding a blue blade in her right hand and a glowing green blade in her left, she is a double [[Soulbound]] who has unsealed her second [[Vessel]] and possesses the strength to deflect a [[Champion]]'s blade.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15" /> After watching [[Calder]] with cold, dark eyes, she killed him by plunging a dagger into him.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref> While she has an ally named [[Meia]], [[Calder]] intends to use the [[Optasia]] to find and punish her in order to get even.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 20</ref> Clad in a hooded gray outfit and a half-[[The mask|mask]] of gray cloth, she uses daggers, including a green one, to fight [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23" /> Shera claims to have killed [[Kelarac]] and was present with [[Calder]] and the [[Regents]], though her eyes later reminded [[Calder]] of a shark's.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 25</ref>}}

[[Calder]] on behalf of the [[Guild]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c7">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 20</ref> Even when unarmed, Shera is capable of killing [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] in various ways.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref> While utilizing the power of [[Bastion's Veil]] and her [[Soulbound]] abilities, she can see through the [[Veil]] and create a cage of gold light and thorny vines using [[Soulbound]] [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" /><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c16">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 16</ref> Despite having served [[The Empire|the Empire]], Shera has faced significant physical hardship, including a sick and tender body, a missing right ear, and wounds from gunfire in her shoulder, stomach, and left arm.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 13</ref><ref {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Shera manages [[Vessels]] that are subject to various urges.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" /> During her confrontation with the Elder, she utilizes her [[Vessels]] alongside a green blade and channels life absorbed from them.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref> After realizing that light was emanating from [[Hightower]], she used [[Bastion]] to ward off the Elder's power by compressing the [[silver mist]] of [[Bastion's Veil|Bastion’s Veil]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" /> Following a cleansing of her body by a golden light, Shera froze just an inch from Darius Allbright{{!}}Darius' chest and grabbed [[Meia]]'s head to shield her eyes from the celestial figures clashing in the void.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" /> She personally stabbed [[Kelarac]] in the back, leading her to question why the [[Guild Heads]] were concerned with a man's survival.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref> As she and the other mortals crowded their ships with allies, Shera considered whether [[Nathanael Bareius|Bareius]], [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]], and [[Jyrine Tessella Marten|Jyrine]] had intended to betray her to the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 25</ref> Now possessing a [[Great Elder]]'s power and energy taken from [[Kelarac]], she commands an army of [[Soulbound]] and maintains twin [[Vessels]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" /><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 26</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] and the rest of the mortals crammed as many allies on their ships as possible.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] has an army of [[Soulbound]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] wondered if [[Nathanael Bareius|Bareius]], [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]], and [[Jyrine Tessella Marten|Jyrine]] had planned to betray her to the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] has energy she took from [[Kelarac]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] possesses a [[Great Elder]]'s power inside her.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] has twin [[Vessels]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Regent of the East}} ===

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“What if Shera decides to attack us while we’re running around on our own?”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“He shot a friend of mine,” Shera said. “We were only supposed to kill people who deserved it. I thought he deserved it.”<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“Protect the Empire,” he had commanded her once. “Even, if necessary, from me.”<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c17" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“They would like to see Gardener Shera.”<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c26" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|“Consultant Shera and I have a separate account to balance,”<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16" />}}
